typeValueContracts.packedAndAlias: Close nominal enum/aggregate fields/base, source names, aliases and recorded mapped origins; enqueue local nominal scopes.
typeValueContracts.runtimeContainers: Fixed unpacked arrays/queues/dynamic arrays recurse element; associative arrays recurse element/index. Range/max-size syntax dependencies audited at owning declaration. Runtime contents are not cached.
typeValueContracts.classAndCovergroup: Fixed provider retains identity; owned local specializations close generic keys/base/interfaces/member graph. Hidden extends constructor arguments are explicitly audited.
typeValueContracts.virtualInterfaces: Complete tracking, imported definition and independently certified local/private prototype required; receiver/modport/parameter metadata cannot rely on nominal type alone.
typeValueContracts.parameterKeys: Integral/string and deep-owned fixed arrays with closed dimensions/nominal identity; dynamic containers and unsupported shapes refuse.
typeValueContracts.otherRuntimeKinds: Builtin floating/event supported through explicit gate. Unsupported canonical runtime types refuse; wrappers used as controls need separate dedicated proof.
